Order 
This first application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail relating to Crime No.218/2024 registered at Police Station- Amarwada, District- Chhindwara, for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(3),
376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 5L/6, 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and Sections 3(1)(w)(i), 3(2)(v) of the Scheduled Castes & Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.

sentences.text:
The applicant is in jail since 31.03.2024.
2.

Having gone through the case-dairy especially the statements of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., it appears that the prosecutrix though was minor but gone with the present applicant and both were in relationship, worked as labourers and lived together for some time.

Although, after coming to know abut the missing report lodged by the parents of the prosecutrix,
they came back and then the offence got NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6106 2 MCRC-3747-2025 registered and applicant was arrested.

Although, in her statements recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., the prosecutrix has stated that physical relations were developed between her and the applicant and that was done forcefully by the applicant, but the DNA report and other reports do not indicate any such act.

It otherwise reveals that the girl has never intimated all these things to anybody but due to the report made by her parents, she came back to her home and then the offence was registered against the applicant.

sentences.text: 3. Considering the facts that the applicant is aged about 24 years, is in jail since last almost one year and the prosecutrix is still not examined, the trial Court is directed to expediate the trial and make all endeavours to get the statements of the prosecutrix recorded expeditiously.

If she does not come to the Court for her examination and order-sheets with regard to such reluctance of the prosecutrix,
are filed, then the bail application can be considered.
4. With the aforesaid, the bail application is rejected.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE Prachi Gandpat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65000189/
